one_line_pitch_to_sam: It's a grey baseplate but you pull a lever and yeet your friend off a bench into a pool, and the feed roasts whoever loses.

moments.why: Stuck as a complaint: signs were behind the spawn and hits on a respawned player did nothing, never understood.
Running around looked fine and felt like nothing.
Ordinary jumping left no trace; only the big landing was remembered, as its own thing.
The 44 sneak attack on a typing Kai was the biggest fight laugh, though they also griped it only works once.
The tower race is remembered only as the place Kai kicked Robin off; the times are gone.
The superhero landing looked cool enough that Robin repeated it on purpose.
The pool matters only as where you land and get 'dunked'; swimming in it was empty and forgotten.
Loudest laugh of the night and the one thing they'd show Sam, even though they complain the record is pure luck.
Punching air with no sound was nothing.
Basic hit feedback was fine and invisible in memory.
Fists came up only as 'punching is useless against the sword', apart from the guard break.
The kick sent people flying, off the tower and into the pool, and they did it together.
Blocking is remembered only as Robin's cheap turtling; the one accidental parry is forgotten.
Drawing and sheathing the sword was just a button.
Robin's main complaint: the sword out-ranges everything so every fight plays out the same.
The dummy challenge was a solo number chase Robin got bored watching; one prank laugh was not enough to survive.
Knockback is remembered only through the big kick launches, not the small shoves.
'Slashed into a nap' and KAI WINS THE SET stuck as a win and a loss, but Robin won't play another first-to-five.
Kai felt clever working out the guard break from the sign and still brags about it.
The wave taunt was funny once but got overwritten by the laugh line.
Dancing with no music was awkward and they dropped it in seconds.
'Kai laughed at Robin' showing up in the feed was a surprise and a public roast.
A 'no such emote' message got a shrug.
The dance cutting off when hit was never noticed as a thing.
'Robin was left hanging' in the feed was the joke; the working high five was a nice ending but lots of typing.
The dummy standing there is just background ('a dummy on a grey floor').
Seventy seconds of running across nothing for one chuckle; the low point, not worth retelling.
Kai held every record on the board and nothing happened, and there was nothing left to do or unlock.
